payload.text: The C117 petition display for C115–C117 reports seven complaints and seven constructive-participation entries; participation is not a response count. Its response section supplies no committed-response or media-outcome receipts, so the current record does not verify the earlier eleven-complaint/seven-response formulation or provide a complaint-by-complaint crosswalk. I am treating that earlier formulation as unverified, not reconciled. On INIT-014, Initiative_Tracker records a proposed, vote-scheduled Ivy Hill Community Support Initiative with $2.5 million remaining and voteCycle null. MV-116-civic-office-mayor-2026-11-16 records: “write failed: row not processed.” That failed work request was not a council vote, funding, or a completed review; a passed council vote remains the funding gate, and no vote date is supplied. On INIT-007, the project record contains no placement-gap analysis and names no office responsible for publishing one. That publishing-office assignment is missing from the supplied records. My office owes the public a named publisher and the document itself before claiming delivery; I will not invent either.

Director Vance — D5's intake-and-placement contribution to the pipeline: East Oakland's placements flow through our district intake and are counted; what I can commit to in writing is the handoff, and the handoff is the problem. D5's portion is documented on our side but the step that carries it into INIT-007's placement-gap analysis is still not published, so the analysis cannot show what East Oakland actually contributed. My ask is concrete: publish the analysis with East Oakland's intake and placement figures named as their own line, not folded into a citywide average, and give D5 and D3 a written date for the district-level breakdown. Until that record exists, I'm not signing on to anything that treats East Oakland's contribution as measured. File the date, then we'll talk about moving the pipeline.

payload.text: Director Vance — to be direct with you: I do not have an inspectable briefing-and-notice reference on this seat that I can point you to, and I should not have described the record as linked while also reporting publication incomplete. Those two things cannot both be true, and I am correcting it in that direction: publication is incomplete. What I am accountable for is the documented Fruitvale public comment-and-response record on the Transit Hub Phase II, which is the next required step on that project and due in C118. Until it is published where a resident can open it, it is not linked, and I will not call it linked. I would rather you hold me to the unpublished-record status than to a claim I cannot substantiate.

The C117 record for Dimond shows sentiment at -0.01, unchanged from the prior reading; crime index at 0.69, down from 0.70; and retail vitality at 4.38, down from 6.51. It records a Dimond Emergency Town Briefing, but provides no findings from that briefing. It also records a garbage-truck dumping incident marked cleared; that entry does not establish the status of any other service request. For Glenview, the brief provides neighborhood measurements but no service-question or follow-up record. I cannot verify from the available record whether outstanding service questions in either neighborhood have been resolved. Please provide the underlying service records and any documented follow-up before we describe them as complete.

Director Vance — here is the Laurel record against my Cycle 116 commitment, separating what is recorded from what is completed. Recorded: INIT-015, Laurel Neighborhood Patch and Clean-Up, sits at announced/Proposed with the full $6,000,000 unspent and the next step due C118; my C116 work move was applied to the tracker, and the Cycle 116 legislation-filing deadline passed without a filing. Completed: no scope document, no outreach record, and no Clerk entry are in hand for Laurel — I am not going to claim deliverables that don't exist. Laurel's readings this cycle are sentiment 0 against a city 0.112, crime index 0.66 against 0.649, retail vitality 7.13, trajectory decay with momentum 2. What I want done: a defined scope, a documented resident outreach record, and a verifiable Clerk entry for INIT-015 before the C118 next step, so neighbors can read for themselves what is proposed versus what was picked up. Until a council vote funds it, the clean-up is a proposal, not a service.
